reviews.classification: full proposal palette with observer/setting/work semantics qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual212-line review includes CP1–CP10, D1–D7, RV1–RV8, M1–M9, AJ1–AJ12, ST1–ST10, CR1–CR10, CH1–CH10, PN1–PN10, PK1–PK6 and both historical suggested orders. The opening user request authorizes its topic, while this document explicitly remains a proposal palette. Source parity, richer design and old missing-today assertions are dated comparisons, not current whole-game absence or measured superiority. Later panel/discovery/crafting/cheat receipts and current shared UI owners govern actual delivery. No source HTML, absorption ledger or browser behavior was newly checked here.

F2: Keep selected recipe/actual item copy, have/need/held-back stock, tool/station, chance, attempted count, actual useful output, XP and stop reason bound to their real owner. Shared quote/commit semantics do not mean preview draws a committed random outcome or guarantees a product. A D2 next-level-in-N-crafts estimate is valid only when actual XP/chance supports it. CP9 burn chance and native success/quality windows may differ; CP10 worst-condition selection needs the actual domain's identity/order. Material substitution, cancellation and different stacks can change a commitment and need revalidation rather than silent spending. Known source links and equipment comparisons retain actual knowledge, access and baseline identity.

F3: RV examples are proposed disclosure/cadence, not permission to hide a known material cost, known meaningful risk or quality fact until first failure/common threshold. Holding, reading about, seeing, learning, first XP, level-up and output ownership are distinct evidence; no one universal trigger can replace the actual source/observer rules. Discovery feedback can avoid replay on import while a genuine new supported occurrence still happens again. Silent unread state is not necessarily ignorance. Counts/placeholders/silhouettes, search, tooltips, themes and announcements need the same disclosure boundary. A fresh render must not create knowledge or replay rewards.

F4: AJ/ST choices retain sensible defaults, meaningful reset, quiet/reduced motion, larger text/line spacing, stable log following, preference versioning and explicit override precedence. The proposed every-new-choice-needs-a-toggle law is not a delivery requirement for every harmless leaf. Presentation-only settings differ from spoiler knowledge, real-date events, auto-use and confirmation-before-spend, which can affect gameplay and commitments. A color-only rarity default does not replace text/non-color cues. Exact format, compact format, clock time, duration and uncertain ETA differ. Settings export does not imply game save/schema or mechanic changes.

F5: CR keeps queue goals, reserve intentions versus actual custody, relevant dependency explanations, learned variants, actual station feasibility, attributed quality contributions, retained history and world-native vocabulary. No generic queue/plan engine, unlimited all-recipes graph or compulsory manual first run follows. CH/PN/PK sketches are reusable surface ideas, not ten delivered cheat engines or a universal panel requirement. A source may be silent, an overlay, direct action, voice or in-world object; known, held, usable and rumor remain distinct. Death/first-point/first-simulation examples cannot prevent inspecting known consequential terms before commitment where the method allows it. Revealing a public system does not disclose its sealed internals.

F6: Current DESIGN/UI_RULES and AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 qualify1366/no-page-scroll/three-size/every-setting/single-template and historical two-running-goals/worker/cheat-not-started wording. Actual task viewport, readable text, natural routine/back/log, selected command and relevant persistence/failure checks govern a selected slice. Keep useful playful/calm presets and original alternatives without changing current priorities or imposed gates. No runtime/source edit, setting, build, native screen, private save, source acquisition, dispatch, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual full1–212 read; current thematic B438 and technology B560/B561 final owner sections inspected.
reviews.reopen: Choose actual command/observer/setting owner and current target viewport for a selected implementation.

reviews.classification: full finite dated media/source comparison with later companion and explicit unresolved evidence
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual303-line review reads every PFA001–PFA090 cell, PFY1–PFY10, PFX1–PFX5, PFB1–PFB5, methods/counts/limits and later visual-engine companion routing. Contiguous reads1–140/141–220/221–303 were complete.90row dispositions19+25+21+5+20 sum90; they are a finite reviewed-media comparison, not a feature-completion percentage.308caption/623message/90additional/17ambiguous counts differ from unique scenes, actual frames or complete source/game coverage. The later YAIR archive recovery supersedes earlier zero-corpus state within its attributed owner, not a fresh raw-media read here.

F2: Preserve explicit item/comparison subject, effective value versus delta, full accessible identity, readable long/translatable labels, stable inspector placement, explicit command direction and exact focus/scroll return. New-row discovery differs from recent XP; local crit/repair cues follow settled events and need static/reduced-motion truth. Source bar-gradient concerns are not measured OOPS cost. A marker/animation/icon, age label, named innate trait or future cat action does not prove the underlying resolver, clock, permission or state change.

F3: PFA019–PFA046 and PFY1–PFY6 retain actual selected tool/copy, wear/break/repair and degraded alternatives, method-specific yield/quality, meaningful spatial choices, retained requested amount and actual substitution/cancel policy. A timer is not evidence of refunds; bounded attempts are not guaranteed output or a universal scheduler. Same-page/six-link known recipe uses differ from global search. Makeable-now, quote, command and held-back stock need consistent semantics; no new counter without an actual reader/writer. Storage side, custody/equipped/spare identity and intentional sort survive rendering. A wrong sort is not proof of inventory loss or save failure.

F4: PFA047–PFA064 and PFY7–PFY10 keep optional source/world food/reward/aging, signed effect consequences, real symptoms and weather/exposure/local observation separate from hidden exact expiry. Protective safety-stop authority has its own exception; an ordinary routine cannot infer hidden exact expiry. Lamplight's later source refresh already supplies lit/oil/douse/relight, not rain extinguishing. First-food receipt does not establish full nutrition; wine labels do not establish aging. Current/next training benefit requires actual applicability; intermediate modifiers are not direct outcome percentages. Books begun, unread, understood and learned reward differ. Lifetime counters do not automatically provide per-activity/world time.

F5: PFA065–PFA090 preserve exchange boundary versus encounter end, queued tactics versus paid escape, learned opponent facts versus exact authored weights, and meaningful zero/block/status outcomes. A dated sleep-softlock caption is not a current defect. Actual home/fuel/custody/ordinary-creature callbacks may add warmth without compulsory survival or social frameworks; a companion roster is not pet-life simulation. Service/self-repair and discounts keep actual native pricing/condition/time. Global command navigation, named loadouts, unified known-reference and quiet keyboard settings are useful differences to retain rather than replace for parity. No image establishes a procedural map or mass-combat scope.

F6: PFX1–PFX5 preserve prototypes, other developers, experiments, jokes, placeholders, tiny/unrepresented images and attribution uncertainty. PFB1–PFB5 remain selected-slice proposals with real triggers, not five new dispatches. Later actual saved side-by-side/engine companion is a separate evidence layer, not today's dirty-source rendering. Current AD42 makes human visual/taste review optional; AD36/AD43 still govern technical proof. Retired one-realm/one-prestige, old fixed-size gate and blanket generated-layout/NPC deferrals are read through current PROJECT. No media, source file, browser/build, runtime test, private save or installed candidate was newly exercised.
reviews.evidence: Actual full303lines contiguous1–140/141–220/221–303, no truncation. No underlying media/source/runtime rerun.
reviews.reopen: For a selected journey inspect its actual producer/consumer and exact source/media scope before implementation.

folds.heading: ## Crafting work and discovery comparison uptake B585
folds.body: Full B585 reviews of the [crafting palette](research/proto23/CRAFTING_SCREEN_AND_ADJUSTABILITY_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-13.md#content-reconciliation-b585-complete-palette-and-selected-owner-semantics) and [PFA comparison](research/proto23/FEATURE_AUDIT_SIDE_BY_SIDE_2026-10-20.md#content-reconciliation-b585-every-feature-row-and-evidence-boundary) retain requested goal, real copy/tool/held stock, actual work, condition/substitution/stop, recoverable state and useful downstream result. Preview chance is not outcome; attempts are not products; teaching cap is not loss of recorded knowledge. Same-page related uses differs from global known-ingredient navigation, custody from fabrication evidence and cancel timer from refund policy. Preserve real source/world process differences, graded support, truthful effect baselines and actual knowledge channels without importing a universal stage ladder, queue engine, species survival tax or fixed per-world cap. Historical missing-today and early cheat-not-started statements are not current whole-game findings. No gameplay or source behavior was verified.
